# Document Control {.unnumbered}

#### Ownership and Review

| Field | Value |
| :--- | :--- |
| Approver and maintainer | Handbook Sample Contributors |
| Scope | Introduction, Chapters 1–8, Appendices A–C and References |
| Review cycle | At least annually and whenever the standard profile publishes a new major version |

#### Maintenance and Contributions

This handbook follows the contribution and review process in `CONTRIBUTING.md` in the repository. Substantive changes require an independent review record before approval; the reviewer must not be the author. Chapter 8 describes how contributions, errata, new editions and retirement are handled.
